key_provisions_or_claims: Pakistan's 2025 AI policy has six pillars: innovation ecosystem, awareness, secure AI, sector transformation, infrastructure, international collaboration.
Policy could raise GDP growth, with gains in agriculture, industry and services.
Gaps: no dedicated AI law or regulator, weak enforcement, pending Personal Data Protection Bill.
Funding, infrastructure and human capital constraints hinder implementation.
Recommends raising R&D funding to 0.5% of GDP, using TVET, pilot projects, and better privacy laws.
annotation.summary_en: PIDE knowledge brief assessing Pakistan's National AI Policy 2025, outlining its six pillars, strengths and limitations, and comparing it with UK, EU, US, China and India. It highlights missing AI law and regulator, funding and infrastructure gaps, and recommends higher R&D funding and stronger privacy laws.
